name: em_furniture_and_interior
description: EM Furniture and Interior - E-commerce Web Application (MVP)

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@em/api & npm run dev --workspace=@em/web & npm run dev --workspace=@em/erp
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@em/web && npm run build --workspace=@em/erp
scripts.deploy:web: vercel build --prod --cwd apps/web && vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod --cwd apps/web
scripts.deploy:erp: vercel build --prod --cwd apps/erp && vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod --cwd apps/erp
scripts.start:prod: npm run migrate --workspace=@em/api && npm run start --workspace=@em/api
